component.name: Experience
component.summary: Blue title bars, a blue panel with a green Start button

description.p: A bright style for the FlickOS desktop in the colors of the early 2000s: deep blue title bars with glossy rounded buttons and a red close button, light grey windows with colorful icons, a black console, pale yellow notifications, and a green hill under a blue sky.

It comes with a layout of the same name: one blue panel at the bottom with a green Start button, the window list, and a lighter blue notification area with the clock. Use sets both; you can still pick another layout in Settings.

screenshot.caption: Files and a terminal in the Experience style and layout
